name: Helm's Bed Lake
summary: In southeastern Dun Morogh, dwarves keep a hole open in Helm's Bed Lake for fresh water. But beasts, troggs, and hostile Dark Iron dwarves make the shore dangerous.

sections.title: A Treacherous Shoreline
sections.body: The ice is firm enough to cross, but the banks are dangerous. Displaced troggs scavenge along the ridges, and wild beasts prowl the edges. South of the water, hostile Dark Iron dwarves have taken an abandoned lodge. They ambush travelers who pass nearby.

faq.q: Why is there an open hole in the middle of the frozen lake?
faq.answer: Local dwarves keep a hole open in the thick ice to reach fresh water through Dun Morogh's freezing cold.

faq.q: What dangers lurk around Helm's Bed Lake?
faq.answer: The solid ice is safe to cross, but wild beasts and displaced troggs prowl the shore. Hostile Dark Iron dwarves occupy an old building south of the water and drive away anyone who comes near.

aliases: dead body at helms bed lake
faq.answer: Narm Faulk is a dwarf whose body lies along Helm's Bed Lake's shore. He fell amid the sudden rise of threats and Dark Iron infiltrators in the area.

faq.q: Are the Dark Iron dwarves officially occupying the lake?
faq.answer: The Dark Iron dwarves have not seized the lake, but an armed squad has taken an abandoned structure just south of it. They use it as a forward position for skirmishes into central Dun Morogh.

angles.text: As a dwarf of Ironforge, you know Helm's Bed Lake as a vital source of fresh water, and its shores have grown less secure. Dark Iron saboteurs and troggs are pushing deeper into Dun Morogh's heartland.
As an Alliance traveler heading east toward Loch Modan, stay alert. The trail south passes close to Dark Iron ambushes.
